description: Ministry of Sports - Order made to amend the Order published in Gaz.Ex.ord. No. 1793/3 of 15.01.2013 by adding two new spots i.e. Kudo and Ballroom Dancers
categorisation: This gazette content contains an order made by the Minister of Sports under Section 28 of the Sports Act, No. 25 of 1973, which involves the amendment of regulations by adding new sports to an official schedule. This constitutes a regulatory matter involving statutory instruments and subsidiary legislation, fitting the Legal/Regulatory classification (Type 5). While it mentions a minister by name, it does not involve government structural changes, personnel appointments, or detailed portfolio responsibilities that would trigger Types 1-3.
